name.zh: HerbalBath 草本沐 没药草本能量油

what.zh: 外用草本能量油，以没药和乳香为主，多达15味中草药。用在肩颈、腰背或腿脚，约10秒感受温热。
what.en: A topical herbal energy oil made with myrrh and frankincense, with up to 15 Chinese herbs. Apply to the shoulders, back or legs and feel warmth in about 10 seconds.

en: Apply to the shoulders, back or legs
Press gently with your palm for about 10 seconds

product.look: a 55ml amber glass bottle with a tall gold cap and a gold-on-maroon label reading MYRRH HERBAL ENERGY OIL, next to its red-and-gold box with a gold teardrop logo

confirm.note: Confirm the customer count before an ad uses it.

audience.zh: 新加坡家庭：喜欢天然、传统产品的55岁以上讲华语的长辈，以及替父母买东西的成年子女。
audience.en: Singapore families: Mandarin-speaking adults 55+ who like natural, traditional products, and their grown-up children who shop for them.

voice.zh: 温暖、朴实、尊重长辈。句子要短，字要大。不夸张，不说医疗功效，不制造焦虑。
voice.en: Warm, plain-spoken, respectful of elders. Short sentences, big type. Never pushy, never medical, never fear-based.
